text: Sam's pet is a hamster. Tell us about his pet. Start with He.
He has a hamster.
Can you start with I and tell us about your pet as if you are Sam?
I have a hamster.
Mia and Leo share one goldfish. Find and fix one word.
They have a goldfish.
Lily's pet is a rabbit. Tell us about her pet in a full sentence.
She has a rabbit.
Pretend you are Max. Max's pet is a goldfish. Tell us about your pet in a full sentence.
I have a goldfish.
Ben and Kim share two guppies. Tell us about their pets in a full sentence.
They have two guppies.
In this story, this parrot can talk. Why do you like it? Use because.
I like this parrot because it can talk.
Now there are two parrots, and both can talk. Explain why you like them. Use because.
I like these parrots because they can talk.
There is one kitten on the story card. Find and fix one word.
I like this kitten because it can play.
Look at the rabbit on the story card. Why does Mia like it? Use because.
Mia likes this rabbit because it has soft fur.
In this story, the lizards catch mosquitoes. Why do you like them? Use because.
I like these lizards because they catch mosquitoes.
Look at the bird on the story card. Why does Leo like it? Use because.
Leo likes this bird because it sings.
Look at the dog on the story card. Describe its body. Start with Its body.
Its body is yellow.
Now describe only the dog's ears. Start with Its ears.
Its ears are white.
Look at the rabbit's ears. Find and fix one word.
Its ears are brown.
Look at the kitten's fur on the story card. Describe it in a full sentence.
Its fur is white.
Look at the lizard's size and color. Describe both in one full sentence.
The lizard is small and green.
Look at the dog's feet on the story card. Describe them in a full sentence.
Its feet are white.
Mia says her hamster is small and Leo says his rabbit is big, so what are they talking about?
They are talking about pets.
Now only Mia is speaking about her rabbit. Tell us what she is doing. Start with She.
She is talking about her rabbit.
Sam and Kim are both speaking. Find and fix one word.
They are talking about goldfish.
Lily says, My hamster is small. Max says, My parrot can talk. What are they talking about?
They are talking about pets.
Only Ben is speaking. He says, My kitten is white. What is he talking about?
He is talking about his kitten.
Mia says, My bird is green. Sam says, My bird is blue. What are they talking about?
They are talking about birds.
Pretend this is your shirt. Compare its color with the sky. Use like.
My shirt is blue like the sky.
Now compare your shoes with the sky. Use like.
My shoes are blue like the sky.
Look at the hat and the grass. Find and fix one word.
My hat is green like the grass.
Pretend this is your bottle. Compare its color with the grass. Use like.
My bottle is green like the grass.
Can you use like to compare the color of your pretend shoes with the sun?
My shoes are yellow like the sun.
Can you use like to compare the color of your pretend shirt with the clouds?
My shirt is white like the clouds.
